name: Venus Rave ~Kuroki Hitomi no Megami~
source:
Our hero is requested to visit the country of Laguna Lake by an old friend. He is to investigate the actions of the ruling princess, Tifaris, and if necessary, restrain her. A truly puzzling request! It is well known that Princess Tifaris is a very wise monarch. However, some suspect that she is actually the wicked witch of Laguna, who had been instrumental in getting the country caught up in the previous continent war.

It seems as though our hero is being led by some mysterious force to meet with so many women. During the investigation, he experiences both love and hate situations first hand. Just where will these experiences lead him? What is the real truth behind the princess?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030222134400/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ha/venus/]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
一位老朋友邀请男主角前往拉古娜湖国。他的任务是调查统治者蒂法莉丝公主的行动，必要时将她控制起来。这真是个令人费解的请求！众所周知，蒂法莉丝公主是一位贤明的君主，但有人怀疑她其实是拉古娜的邪恶女巫，正是她让这个国家卷入了上一次大陆战争。

男主角仿佛受到某种神秘力量引导，接连遇见许多女性。在调查过程中，他亲身经历了爱与恨。这些经历究竟会把他引向何方？公主背后隐藏的真相又是什么？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030222134400/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/ha/venus/]gamelexgs[/url]]
